description: This file defines an abstract class 'ViewerInputMethod' that implements the 'Viewer' interface. It manages a custom HTML element, sets up event listeners for viewer interactions, and interacts with presenter and UI data components within a trace visualization context.

classes.name: ViewerInputMethod
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the Viewer interface, managing viewer input methods with event handling and presenter interaction.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates the presenter with a new trace position.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve views; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve trace dependencies; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: imeUiCallback
methods.description: Updates the input element's data with new UI data, resetting to null first to trigger Angular change detection.

methods.name: addViewerEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners on the HTML element for various viewer events, delegating updates to the presenter.

methods.name: initialisePresenter
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize the presenter with traces and storage.
